subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands rests at a small canvas on a tabletop easel. One hand steadies the frame while the other draws a loaded brush through a soft grey wash, and warm color blooms outward from the stroke like a quiet sunrise. The image is entirely symbolic and hopeful — an abstract visual metaphor for healing and restoration, with no clinical setting, no distress, and no depiction of trauma itself.

subject.sensitive_handling: This slot represents art therapy for trauma survivors, a sensitive topic. Depict only an abstract, hopeful visual metaphor of color emerging from grey — no clinical setting, no medical props, no facial expressions, no tears, no bandages, and no reference to the trauma itself. Tone must read as calm and restorative, suitable for a general-audience career quiz.

composition.layout: centered single scene — canvas as the calm focal anchor, brush stroke leading the eye outward
composition.negative_space: generous transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: tabletop edge only — no wall, no clinical furniture
composition.thumbnail_readability: canvas silhouette with color bloom readable at 160px width
